Table: admissions (hosp)
Description: Contains details for each hospital admission, including timing, demographics, admission source, and discharge info. Each admission has a unique hadm_id.
Columns:
  - subject_id: Unique patient identifier; links to PATIENTS table. Patients may have multiple admissions.
  - hadm_id: Unique identifier for each hospital admission (2000000–2999999).
  - admittime: Date and time of hospital admission.
  - dischtime: Date and time of hospital discharge.
  - deathtime: Date and time of in-hospital death, if applicable.
  - admission_type: Classifies admission urgency (e.g., elective, urgent, emergency).
  - admit_provider_id: Anonymous ID for admitting provider; consistent across database.
  - admission_location: Location of patient before hospital admission.
  - discharge_location: Patient's destination after hospital discharge.
  - insurance: Patient's insurance for this admission.
  - language: Patient's language for this admission.
  - marital_status: Patient's marital status for this admission.
  - ethicity: Patient's ethnicity for this admission.
  - edregtime: Date and time of emergency department registration.
  - edouttime: Date and time of emergency department discharge.
  - hospital_expire_flag: Indicates in-hospital death: 1 = died, 0 = survived.
  - text: Narrative summary of admission reason.

Table: chartevents (icu)
Description: chartevents stores all patient charted data during ICU stays, including vital signs, ventilator settings, lab values, and other clinical observations.
Columns:
  - subject_id: Unique patient identifier.
  - hadm_id: Unique hospital admission identifier.
  - stay_id: Unique ICU stay identifier.
  - caregiver_id: Unique identifier for the documenting caregiver.
  - charttime: Time the observation was made.
  - storetime: Time the observation was entered or validated.
  - itemid: Identifier for the measurement type (e.g., heart rate).
  - value: Measured value for the itemid; may be text or numeric.
  - valuenum: Numeric value for the itemid, if applicable.
  - valueuom: Unit of measurement for the value.
  - warning: Indicates if a warning was documented for this observation.
  - label: Name of the concept for the itemid.
  - abbreviation: Common abbreviation for the label (Metavision only).
  - linksto: Name of the event table containing this itemid.
  - category: Type of data the itemid represents (e.g., ABG, IV Medication).
  - unitname: Unit of measurement for the itemid, if available.
  - param_type: Data type recorded: date, number, or text.
  - lownormalvalue: Lower reference range for the measurement.
  - highnormalvalue: Upper reference range for the measurement.
